summary.en: A dimmed bento wall lights up cell by cell: a comet runs once round each edge and the content brightens and floats up; then the camera eases in.
summary.zh: 压暗待命的 bento 墙逐格点亮：一道彗星流光沿格边跑一圈，格内内容随即提亮上浮；全亮后镜头缓推收住。

fits: A feature overview or a wall of capabilities that is already in place and should switch on rather than pour in; a calm, dark brand passage.
notFor: Light grounds (the dimmed state reads as faded, not waiting); a wall that should arrive with energy (fly-in decks); a second whole-wall light effect in the same film.

overlaps.note: the comet head on one element; bento-wall runs it over a whole wall on an even beat
a wall that flies in (displacement); bento-wall lights a wall in place
a sweep materialises a whole interface at once; bento-wall switches cells on one by one

intent.en: Show that a whole set of capabilities is already there and simply switches on, so the viewer reads a calm, complete overview instead of things pouring in.
intent.zh: 表现一整面功能本来就在原位、只是被逐一点亮，观众读到的是一份沉稳、完整的总览，而不是一堆东西涌进来。

content.en: 3 or 6 cells, each a label and a title (en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 7) with an optional number, image or figure; an eyebrow (en ≤ 24 chars, zh ≤ 10) and a title line (en ≤ 34 chars, zh ≤ 14).
content.zh: 3 或 6 格，每格一个标签和一个标题（英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 7 字），可带数字、图片或图形；一行眉标（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）和一行标题（英文 ≤ 34，中文 ≤ 14）。

fits.zh: 已经在原位、要“亮起来”而不是“涌进来”的功能总览或能力墙；沉稳的暗场品牌段。

notFor.zh: 浅色底（压暗态读作褪色而不是待命）；要带着冲劲进场的墙（用 deck-deal 飞入）；同一支片里第二次整墙光效。

pairs.note: the wall settles into a brand lockup

en: Use at most one whole-wall light effect per film; this and a blueprint wireframe draw together count as two.
Do not mix a fly-in into the light-up; a wall that should move belongs to deck-deal.
The dimmed state needs a dark ground; on light grounds it reads as a fault.
zh: 一支片整墙光效最多一次；本场景和蓝图描线同片用就算两次。
点亮时别再叠飞入位移；要动的墙去用 deck-deal。
压暗待命态依赖暗底；亮底上读作褪色故障。

upstream.name: 逐格点亮
upstream.summary: 暗场 3×2 bento 墙压暗待命，琥珀流光逐格描边一圈、内容随即提亮上浮，全亮后镜头缓推收住
upstream.use: 功能墙/卡片墙/整页界面的整体亮相；内容已在原位、要"显形"而非"涌入"的段落
